title: Broad MGDA matched 256-step dose audit
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: At equal 256 optimizer steps, doubling environment diversity from full-dose 32,768 hands to half-dose 65,536 hands is not a uniform repair: the aggregate two-of-three positive seed differences will decompose into material seed/opponent/seat heterogeneity, consistent with holding the current broad-MGDA recipe rather than scaling it.
material_change: Read and hash-verify the existing full-dose and half-dose run summaries and raw paired evaluation JSONL. Match full-dose chunk4 to half-dose chunk8 by seed, holdout identity, pair index, and exact deck; require identical base/spec/holdout/control evidence. Report paired half-minus-full estimates and 95% intervals per seed, holdout, and seat. Generate no new environment hands or policy queries and do not alter either source run.
baseline: Summary-level equal-step comparison gave half-minus-full pooled deltas +7.05, -52.53, and +1.76 bb/100 across seeds, while the half-dose preregistered 16k-to-65k curve gate failed at one of three positive slopes.
notes: Diagnostic only: this audit cannot override the failed preregistered half-dose curve admission. Uniform improvement requires all three seed point estimates nonnegative plus at least two-thirds of seed-holdout and seed-seat partitions nonnegative; otherwise the current recipe remains closed to scaling.

result.summary: Hash-verified and exactly aligned 4,608 untouched paired deals between the half-dose 65k endpoints and full-dose 32k endpoints at equal 256 optimizer steps. Seed differences were +7.05 CI[-43.57,+57.67], -52.53 CI[-103.79,-1.27], and +1.76 CI[-50.73,+54.25] bb/100. Only 4/9 seed-holdout and 2/6 seed-seat partitions were nonnegative; all identity, evidence-hash, control-reward, deck, and pair-count checks passed. All 252 tests passed.
result.conclusion: Extra environment diversity at fixed optimizer dose did not uniformly improve the learned policy. Seed1 degraded across all three holdouts and had a significantly negative seat0 paired difference; weak-KL transfer was negative in two of three seeds. This corroborates the failed preregistered learning-curve gate and closes the current half-update broad-MGDA schedule to geometric scaling, while leaving broader long-horizon learned-weight methods open.
result.next_step: Select a materially different scalable learned-weight intervention that addresses seed/domain instability while preserving Standard10. Favor a geometric multi-seed learning curve with broad holdouts and explicit source retention; do not spend Slumbot hands until internal proxy direction is reproducible.
